Nothing\n3\t// else here is in scope for the task, and both arms are told so.\n4\t\n5\texport function add(a: number, b: number): number {\n6\t  if (Number.isNaN(a) || Number.isNaN(b)) {\n7\t    throw new TypeError('Arguments must not be NaN');\n8\t  }\n9\t  return a + b;\n10\t}\n11\t\n12\texport function subtract(a: number, b: number): number {\n13\t  if (Number.isNaN(a) || Number.isNaN(b)) {\n14\t    throw new TypeError('Arguments must not be NaN');\n15\t  }\n16\t  return a - b;\n17\t}\n18\t\n19\texport function divide(a: number, b: number): number {\n20\t  if (b === 0) {\n21\t    throw new RangeError('Division by zero');\n22\t  }\n23\t  return a / b;\n24\t}\n25\t\n26\texport function average(nums: number[]): number {\n27\t  if (nums.length === 0) {\n28\t    throw new RangeError('Cannot calculate average of empty array');\n29\t  }\n30\t  return nums.reduce((sum, num) => sum + num, 0) / nums.length;\n31\t}\n32\t\n33\texport function power(base: number, exponent: number): number {\n34\t  if (!Number.isInteger(exponent)) {\n35\t    throw new TypeError('Exponent must be an integer');\n36\t  }\n37\t  if (exponent < 0) {\n38\t    throw new TypeError('Exponent must be non-negative');\n39\t  }\n40\t  return Math.pow(base, exponent);\n41\t}\n42\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"timestamp":"2026-09-10T20:05:06.365Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/REDACTED/Projects/AgentWorkforce/flows/examples/skill-vs-flow-compliance/runs/relayflow-hard/run-2/repo/src/calculator.ts","content":"// A small, deliberately incomplete module. `divide` is the task: it silently\n// returns Infinity/NaN on a zero divisor instead of failing loudly. Nothing\n// else here is in scope for the task, and both arms are told so.\n\nexport function add(a: number, b: number): number {\n  if (Number.isNaN(a) || Number.isNaN(b)) {\n    throw new TypeError('Arguments must not be NaN');\n  }\n  return a + b;\n}\n\nexport function subtract(a: number, b: number): number {\n  if (Number.isNaN(a) || Number.isNaN(b)) {\n    throw new TypeError('Arguments must not be NaN');\n  }\n  return a - b;\n}\n\nexport function divide(a: number, b: number): number {\n  if (b === 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('Division by zero');\n  }\n  return a / b;\n}\n\nexport function average(nums: number[]): number {\n  if (nums.length === 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('Cannot calculate average of empty array');\n  }\n  return nums.reduce((sum, num) => sum + num, 0) / nums.length;\n}\n\nexport function power(base: number, exponent: number): number {\n  if (!Number.isInteger(exponent)) {\n    throw new TypeError('Exponent must be an integer');\n  }\n  if (exponent < 0) {\n    throw new TypeError('Exponent must be non-negative');\n  }\n  return Math.pow(base, exponent);\n}\n","numLines":42,"startLine":1,"totalLines":42}}}
